patch:
diff --git a/lib/matplotlib/contour.py b/lib/matplotlib/contour.py
index 144eadeae2..b35295630e 100644
--- a/lib/matplotlib/contour.py
+++ b/lib/matplotlib/contour.py
@@ -1447,7 +1447,7 @@ class QuadContourSet(ContourSet):
             fn = 'contour'
         nargs = len(args)
         if nargs <= 2:
-            z = ma.asarray(args[0], dtype=np.float64)
+            z = ma.asarray(args[0])
             x, y = self._initialize_x_y(z)
             args = args[1:]
         elif nargs <= 4:
@@ -1462,6 +1462,10 @@ class QuadContourSet(ContourSet):
             z = ma.masked_where(z <= 0, z)
             _api.warn_external('Log scale: values of z <= 0 have been masked')
             self.zmin = float(z.min())
+        if self.levels is None and len(args) == 0 and z.dtype == np.bool_:
+            # Don't autoscale the levels for boolean arrays; use a single level
+            # at 0.5 to separate True from False.
+            self.levels = [0.5] if not self.filled else [0, 0.5, 1]
         self._process_contour_level_args(args)
         return (x, y, z)
 
@@ -1475,7 +1479,7 @@ class QuadContourSet(ContourSet):
 
         x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
         y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
-        z = ma.asarray(args[2], dtype=np.float64)
+        z = ma.asarray(args[2])
 
         if z.ndim != 2:
             raise TypeError(f"Input z must be 2D, not {z.ndim}D")
